notes.title: Ver1.101
notes.content: Update: Added sections for "ねん", "くみ", and "なまえ" to the newly added Kanji tests. Disabled saving during Kanji test gameplay. Scoring is still available as usual.

Added Kanji tests for (Washoku ), (vegetables), (place names), (tourist spots), and (historical figures).
Added (yellow) and (blue) ink options to Free Mode.
Added (Haiku 1), (Haiku 2), (New Year’s card), and (Floor) to Free Mode.
Displayed (Calligraphy), (Haiku 1), (Haiku 2), and (New Year’s card) on the wall.
Update: Fixed the issue where the brush thickness changed suddenly in parts related to "ねん" and "くみ". Also corrected the date input field for the Sutra Copying feature.
Update: Removed the eraser that was placed when selecting "Standard Size" or "Longer Size" in Free Mode due to issues with its behavior.
The stroke order has been added to both Hiragana and Katakana
The update process for Steam Achievements has been modified to ensure timely synchronization.
